\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows,positioning}

\makeatletter
\pgfarrowsdeclare{process tip}{process tip}{
  \pgfutil@tempdima=.4pt
  \advance\pgfutil@tempdima by.3\pgflinewidth
  \pgfarrowsleftextend{-4\pgfutil@tempdima}
  \pgfarrowsrightextend{2\pgfutil@tempdima}
}{
  \pgfutil@tempdima=.4pt
  \advance\pgfutil@tempdima by.3\pgflinewidth
  \pgfpathmoveto{\pgfqpoint{2\pgfutil@tempdima}{0pt}}
  \pgfpathlineto{\pgfqpoint{-4\pgfutil@tempdima}{3\pgfutil@tempdima}}
  \pgfpathlineto{\pgfqpoint{-2\pgfutil@tempdima}{0pt}}
  \pgfpathlineto{\pgfqpoint{-4\pgfutil@tempdima}{-3\pgfutil@tempdima}}
  \pgfpathclose
  \pgfusepathqfillstroke
}
\pgfarrowsdeclarealias{process alias}{process alias}{process tip}{process tip}
\pgfarrowsdeclarereversed{process reversed}{process reversed}{process tip}{process tip}
\makeatother

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[node distance=19mm,box/.style={draw,rounded corners=2pt,minimum width=18mm,minimum height=8mm}]
  \node[box] (input) {Input};
  \node[box,right=of input] (check) {Check};
  \node[box,right=of check] (done) {Done};
  \draw[blue,very thick,-{process alias}] (input) -- node[above]{accept} (check);
  \draw[red,thick,-{process reversed}] (check) -- node[above]{retry} (done);
  \draw[green!50!black,thick,{process reversed}-{process alias}] (input.south) |- (done.south);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
